title: TaskFindResult
description: Wire shape returned by the Task Access Layer for find / list / snapshot calls. One job record plus an optimistic-concurrency token so a later mutate or transition can be rejected when the underlying disk record has moved on. Mirrors backend/Services/TaskAccess/TaskAccessRecords.cs and the existing JobInfo wire shape from backend/Models/JobModels.cs. Phase 1 schema; the layer's read API is implemented in phase 2.

jobId.description: Job folder slug, unique per watchPath. Matches JobInfo.id.

watchPath.description: Resolved watch path that owns this job. Matches JobInfo.watchPath.

version.description: Monotonic per-record counter. Bumped on every mutation that the layer itself applied.

mtime.description: UTC mtime of job.json at the moment the version counter was bumped. The (version, mtime) pair is the optimistic-concurrency token.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency token for this record. Consumers hand it back on the next mutate / transition call so the layer can reject stale writes with status Conflict.

job.description: Full JobInfo wire shape as defined by backend/Models/JobModels.cs. Phase 1 leaves the shape additive; the round-trip test is added when phase 2 lands the in-memory store.
